newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Metal Manufactures in Asia cable jv.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Metal Manufactures in Asia cable jv.

text.p: Metal Manufactures Ltd said on Monday it has signed an agreement for an Asia-Pacific optical cable joint venture with BICC Plc and Corning Inc.
Metal Manufactures said it had entered the agreement with Corning through its 50/50 joint venture with BICC Plc, BICC Cables Asia-Pacific Pte Ltd.
The new joint venture, to be known as BICCOR, will be 60 percent owned by BICC Cables Asia-Pacific and 40 percent by Corning.
The agreement was intended to cover all optical cable manufacturing facilities to be developed in the region, Metal Manufactures managing director Glenn Dudley said.
Metal Manufactures and Corning have a joint venture optical fibre manufacturing operation in Melbourne, established in 1985.
Dudley said the agreement would extend the relationship.
"We have a number of promising opportunites for optical cable manufacture and supply in Asia-Pacific and we will now be in a stronger position to carry these forward," he said.
Dudley said the agreement would accelerate the company's plans for developing a regional optical cable business in the Asia-Pacific.
